messages:
Eli: FYI preflight failed: deploy-bot couldn't verify artifact for `metrics-agent` during canary promote. checksum mismatch. anyone?

deploy-bot: Promote blocked: metrics-agent@canary-20260315 -> expected sha256:deadbeef... observed sha256:feedface...

Dana: build 9422 uploaded at 20:01 UTC. Registry HEAD returned 200 but range GETs returned 206 partial sometimes.

ci-bot: Triggered rebuild #9425 with NO_REMOTE_CACHE=1.

Eli: Immediate plan: pin canary to last-good digest from previous smoke (sha256:deadbeefcafe1234), promote, run quick smoke. If green, hold release and investigate registry ETag/partial reads.

Dana: Running pin promote: `deploybot promote --service metrics-agent --image metrics-agent@sha256:deadbeefcafe1234 --env canary --reason "pin-after-range-206"`

deploy-bot: Pin applied -> canary = metrics-agent@sha256:deadbeefcafe1234

ci-bot: Smoke #9426 started: quick-health, ingest-check.

Dana: Smoke passed. latency ok. Rebuild #9425 finished; new upload digest matches pinned.

infra-oncall: Root cause likely background compaction touching multipart temp parts. I'll file INF-1740 and disable compaction during active uploads. Add deploybot pre-promote HEAD+range double-check and 3 retry attempts.

release-manager: Applying manual hold for 45m. If metrics stable, we'll remove and proceed. Added release note: "Canary briefly pinned due to registry partial-read checksum mismatch; no user impact."

Eli: Thanks - monitoring for 30m then proceed.
